articles.summary: Biohacking and DIY medicine are reshaping health, longevity and genetic science, creating new risks and considerations for life sciences insurers navigating this rapidly evolving space.
articles.title: Hacking Humanity: The Promise and Peril of DIY Medicine and Longevity

articles.summary: Skyward Specialty announced a strategic partnership with Sixfold, an AI underwriting company transforming insurance workflows, to accelerate its progress toward fully AI-powered underwriting across U.S.-based property and casualty lines. The collaboration reinforces the Company’s commitment to data-driven, insight-rich underwriting by combining Sixfold’s AI-driven analysis with human expertise to enhance speed, consistency and decision quality.
articles.title: Skyward Specialty and Sixfold Partner to Advance AI-Powered Underwriting - Skyward Specialty Insurance
